results.name: Barbell Curl
steps: While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly bring the weight back down to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
steps: Grab a barbell with a shoulder width pronated or supinated grip.
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
Pull the weight toward your upper abdomen.
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Curl
steps: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

results.name: Ez Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall, hold EZ bar with shoulder-width underhand grip.
Curl bar upward, keeping elbows tucked and torso stable.
Pause and squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until arms fully extended.

results.name: Ez Bar Close Grip Curl
steps: Stand upright, hold EZ bar with narrow underhand grip, elbows pinned to sides.
Curl bar upward by flexing elbows, keep shoulders still throughout movement.
Squeeze biceps at top, pause briefly for maximum contraction.
Lower bar slowly under control until arms fully extended.

results.name: Ez Bar Reverse Curl
steps: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

results.name: Ez Bar Drag Curl
steps: Grab an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Ez Bar Spider Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench and hold an incline bench with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bat up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Ez Bar Reverse Spider Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench and hold the EZ bar with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl
steps: Position yourself on preacher bench; grasp EZ bar with underhand grip, elbows extended.
Slowly curl bar towards shoulders; keep upper arms stationary, focus on biceps.
Lower bar back to starting position; maintain control, repeat for reps.

results.name: EZ Bar Reverse Preacher Curl
steps: Sit on preacher bench, grip EZ bar overhand at shoulder width, elbows resting on pad.
Curl bar towards chin, keep elbows stable.
Lower bar slowly to starting position, maintaining control throughout.

results.name: Barbell Drag Curl
steps: Grab a barbell with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Landmine T Bar Rows
steps: Grab a v bar and place it under the bar's collar.
Hinge forward with a flat back and pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.

results.name: Landmine Concentration Curl
steps: Start on one knee facing the landmine, holding the end of the barbell with your hand on the side of your forward leg.
While keeping your elbow braced against the inside of your knee, curl the barbell upward towards your shoulder, then lower it back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Bicep Curl
steps: Stand beside the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart while grasping the end of the landmine barbell with the hand farther away from the landmine attachment, palm facing up and your elbow close to your side.
Curl the barbell up towards your opposite shoulder, contracting your bicep muscles, then slowly lower the barbell back down.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Barbell Supinated Row
steps: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, pause briefly, and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row
steps: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart and your palms facing towards your body.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a pronated (overhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing towards your body (supinated grip), and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Pronated Row
steps: Grab the barbell with an overhand grip. Hinge forward while keeping your back flat until your torso is about parallel with the ground.
Let your arms hang freely.
Pull the bar to your torso while tucking your elbows in slightly.
Extend your elbows fully before initiating the next rep.

results.name: Barbell Pronated Pendlay Row
steps: Start hinged forward with a flat back and the plates resting on the floor. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
Pull the bar to your sternum.
Return the plates back to the floor and let the bar come to a full dead stop.
Then initiate the next rep.

results.name: Barbell Meadows Row
steps: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing sideways with a staggered stance and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.
*Named after the late John Meadows
